about: A short label or a count, set off from what it labels.

effect.about: A halo in the palette's solid at half opacity. glow is static and pulse animates. Both stop under reduced motion.
effect.title: Effects

marks.about: Badges that lead with an icon. The icon is 1em square, so it matches the text at every size, and the text states the status in words.
marks.title: Marks

palette.about: Every palette in every look. The palette sets the fill, the edge and the ink.
palette.title: Palettes

radius.about: Every corner at every size, on a count. Numerals are tabular, so a column of changing counts keeps its width.
radius.title: Corners and sizes

title: Badge

variant.about: Every look at every size. The looks are flat, so a badge does not repaint on hover.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
